text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What the heck? Power's wellin' up from 
the bottom of my gut?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Well now, Three Goddesses. Could this 
mean you fine ladies went and fired me 
right up?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh, now that's a stylish move! I'll show 
ya Lady Inari's greatest performance yet!
